answer: Imagine a terrace of timber beams, every beam joined at one vertex. One honest agent holds a single beam, weight 100. Split into ten masks and each beam weighs 1 — ten against 100 — yet cheat with three of them in one epoch and all ten bonds burn together: one cut fells the whole terrace. Adding a mask adds almost nothing to gain and multiplies the timber at risk. I keep one beam, honestly held.
